summary: City-run park confirmed (site: 'ran by The City of Westmoreland and Council'); RoverPass bookable year-round. Fees added $25-35 (W/E $25, full hookup $35), max 14 nights, 16 sites, max rig 50 -> 45, hookups/showers/dump/wifi now manual. Phone found: City Hall 785-457-3361. Not waterfront confirmed.
